design: Five synthetic cases, two fresh drafts per case. Stateless reviews of identical immutable proposal and sources, same model/schema/output limit. A self-check; B grounded SR principles in one call, not SR integration. Reverse A/B order for repetition 2. No repairs, injected errors, model revision, customer round, or independent human assessor.
cost_policy: Reserve full 0.152 USD durably before every dispatch; never release reservation on timeout/error/restart. Max 30 reservations across resumption. UTF-8 request-body bytes plus 4096 framing allowance must be <=32000 (conservative byte-level input token bound, including schema). Reject larger requests before dispatch. No tools, no hidden conversation, no priority, no automatic retries. Report usage-derived list-price cost and cache-write upper estimate separately; missing usage has unknown actual cost and retains full reservation. Stop on usage exceeding bounds or unexpected model.
